description: An app's Uptime tab: what counts as up, extra checks (check_id), response times by region, 30-day uptime and downtime (from uptimeSince for a younger app), SSL and domain expiry, cron heartbeats (heartbeat_id), maintenance (maintenance_id) and the status page. One outage: get_incident.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

name: get_uptime
title: Uptime details
